$description: How semantic.tokens.json becomes CSS; cssNames and files read as in primitives.config.json, the files go to src/theme/tokens/semantic/. Colour roles are the kit's own `--guk-<family>-*` theme variables, read by the functional utilities of src/theme/tokens/colorRoles.css (`bg-*`, `text-*`, `border-*`, `icon-*`, `ring-*`) and gradients.css; shadows are Tailwind's `--shadow-*`, so its own `shadow-*` utility resolves them. preview: the files of design-system/tokens/preview/; each maps the selector of a mode to the token documents merged over the default theme, in order. `:root[data-theme]` outranks Tailwind's `:root` theme rule where that rule is not in a cascade layer.
